visualCharacteristics: Base: full-bleed photo with bottom-to-top gradient overlay and white text directly on the image. Option article: blog article header with breadcrumbs, tag line, em tag pills and author avatar. Option hero-card: full-width photo with a white rounded, shadowed text card (H1, subheading, paragraph) overlapping the photo's bottom-right corner and overhanging below it; the card stacks under the image on mobile. Option hero-callout: compact centered band (no photo background, no gradient) with a small ~72px icon above a contact heading (e.g. 'Got a Question? Call ...' with bold parts) and a paragraph (TDD line); white text intended for a colored (purple) section.
contentPattern: Two rows: row 1 is a single image cell; row 2 is a content cell with an H1, optional eyebrow/subheading, body paragraph(s) and optional CTA links. Block JS moves the picture (or wraps a bare img in a picture) and the content cell to the top level. For hero-callout the image row holds a small icon instead of a full-bleed photo.
usage: Page-opening hero. Use the base for full-bleed overlay heroes, article for blog article headers, and hero-card when the text should sit on a separate white card overlapping the photo. Use hero-callout for a centered icon-over-text contact callout band, typically in a section styled purple.
reuseGuidance: Keep the image row + content row model for every option. Add a new option class only when the layout differs visibly from overlay, article and card treatments.
